test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

Shyla said to me, “What a skilful tailor she is!”

options.text: Shyla said that she was a very skilful tailor.
Shyla exclaimed to me if she was a very skilful tailor.
Shyla exclaimed that she was a very skilful tailor.
Shyla exclaimed that she is a very skilful tailor.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3).** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the steps for changing the sentence from **direct **to **indirect speech:**
 
• The **comma **and inverted **commas **are removed and '**that**' is added.
 
• The exclamation mark **'!'** in the direct speech indicates the use of the reporting verb '**exclaimed**' in indirect speech.
 
• Also, if the reporting verb is in the past tense, we usually change the present form to a past form in reported speech.
 
• Hence, **'is' **is changed into '**was**'.
 
• When an **exclamatory sentence** is changed into indirect speech 'what' will be removed and the sentence will become a simple sentence.
 
• '**she**' will remain unchanged as it refers to the speaker of the reporting speech 'Shyla'.

Therefore, the correct answer is ***"Shyla exclaimed that she was a very skilful tailor."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
